about_the_game:
Wreak havoc across the galaxy as a sanitation worker with nothing to lose.

You’re Drax Gorbuloid—a low-level grunt cleaning up cosmic trash for a sinister mega-corporation called Binary Express. When the job goes sideways, you’ll have to race, sabotage, and blast your way across alien worlds in an open-ended struggle for survival.

Explore planets. Break stuff. Get rich or die trying.

  • Drive, hijack, or fight your way across vibrant alien cities, slums, and sewer zones.

  • Take on shady gigs, corporate sabotage, or just cause chaos for fun.

  • Fight off debt collectors, corporate enforcers, and mutated space freaks.

  • Uncover secrets of the Binary Express megacorp—and maybe bring it all crashing down.

A colorful sandbox full of cosmic chaos and hilarious hijinks.

Zoom through space cities, mess with alien tech, and take odd jobs from bizarre characters—or just cause mischief for the fun of it. There’s always something wild to do, somewhere strange to explore, and some rule to break.

If you love open-world adventures, quirky aliens, and games that let you play your way—this is your kind of galaxy.

short_description: Blast through the galaxy as Drax Gorbuloid, a grumpy space janitor of mega-corp Binary Express, tangled in a deadly corporate conspiracy. Clean up cosmic messes, uncover secrets, and try to survive across hostile planets in this darkly comedic sci-fi action adventure created by Pantelis Kassotis.
